Your holdings: SOXL (-32.61%) and SPAL (-33.88%) are in "SELL" status, leveraged, and showing significant losses. These need immediate attention, especially with margin amplifying drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on rising Treasury yields and any further signs of a broader market pullback. Also, monitor the AI tax subsidy discussions for big tech.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions given the market's mixed signals and your margin exposure.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL and SPAL. Both are leveraged, decaying, and in deep drawdown, amplified by margin.
If adding to chip exposure, MU has an ACCUMULATE setup: entry 1081.2-1080.12, stop 1078.27, backed by positive news.
